jobs.prompt:
Second Opus security review of the orchestrator-mode guard returned FAIL. Fix every finding below; add a test per finding in tests/orchestrator-mode-review3.test.mjs. Where a feature is hard to make safe, REMOVE it from the allowlist instead of parsing it (smaller allowlist is the goal). Do not weaken any deny; keep all existing guard tests passing (tests/orchestrator-mode*.test.mjs, tests/handbuild*.test.mjs, tests/guard*.test.mjs).
H1 tools/handbuild-guard.mjs: when cwd and CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR disagree the guard prefers any folder under cwd that has a .swarm marker (markers are creatable with Write). When CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is set and exists, always use it; nested markers belong to the outer project.
H2 tools/shell-writes.mjs: worker status is decided from the session cwd; cd into a real .swarm/workspaces/<id> then counts as a verified worker and the mode is off. Decide worker status from something the swarm launcher sets in the worker environment (a launcher-set variable plus the matching run record), never from cwd; and deny cd into .swarm/workspaces and .swarm/worktrees (and any path under .swarm except reading).
H3 env vars turn the mode off: CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR set to a missing path makes orchestratorModeApplies and enforceOrchestratorMode false; NODE_ENV=test, SWARM_TEST_TMP and SWARM_OMODE_SCRATCH_EXEMPT switch off exemptions with no proof this is a test. Compute active from the resolved root only (fall back to cwd walk-up when the variable is missing or invalid, and stay ON); restrict test switches to a signed marker file or remove them and give the tests another way (fixtures that create the real condition).
H4 omSedSubstitutionOnly/omSedReadOnly: substitution flags are only checked when the delimiter is a slash and script-file options are ignored, so a substitution that writes a file or runs a command passes. Remove sed substitution from the allowlist entirely (keep only read-only sed -n with a fixed print form if tests need it; otherwise remove sed).
H5 omGhApiArgsOk: only exact spellings of the method and field flags are blocked; attached and = forms switch to POST/PUT. Remove gh api from the allowlist except a fixed list of read-only GET endpoints with no flags other than the endpoint path, or remove it.
M1 handbuild-guard: bad JSON or a non-object payload is allowed when CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is unset; fall back to projectRootOf(process.cwd()) and deny when that finds a swarm project.
M2 swarm subcommands: unknown dash options are skipped as globals without consuming their value, so the guard checks a different subcommand than swarm runs. Accept only known global options with their value counts; refuse anything else. run, integrate, update, go, decide and change must not pass unchecked: allow only the exact forms the orchestrator needs (existing tests show them) and refuse the rest.
M3 the handbuild off-file also turns orchestrator mode off, and so does a .swarm folder with only bootstrap entries. Orchestrator mode must be decided on its own (its own off-file only; a .swarm directory at the root means ON).
M4 off-file protection covers Edit and Write only. On the Bash path run the protected-path check (orchestratorModeProtectedWriteRel) on every write target before any approval applies, and resolve the parent folder through symlinks when the file does not exist yet.
M5 reads: head, tail, grep, rg, sort, uniq, cut and find operands never pass through omReadOperandOk; words with variable expansion, globs or ~user are checked as literal text; a path that does not exist falls back to inside-project. Check every operand of every allowlisted command, reject operands that expand ($, backtick, glob chars, ~), and treat a nonexistent path by its resolved parent.
M6 gh auth status is allowed with any options so an option can print the token: allow only exact option sets for gh read commands (no --show-token).
L1 a cd made inside a subshell is kept for later relative paths: reject cd that is not a top-level command, or reset cwd when the subshell closes.
L2 SWARM_GUARD_TIMEOUT_MS and the hang fault are not limited to test mode: ignore them unless the signed test marker from H3 exists.
L3 swarm is looked up through PATH, which the session controls: resolve the installed swarm path (the launcher recorded in ~/.project-swarm) and require the command to be that exact path or the plain word swarm only when PATH resolution lands on it.
jobs.ignoreTestsReason: tests listed in context cover the guard; the full suite runs before merge
